---
title: "Calculator: $Z$-testing"
author: Tom Coleman and Ellie Trace
format: html
abstract-title: Summary
abstract: A calculator to provide $p$-values when a $Z$-test is being used.
filters: 
  - shinylive
---

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library("webexercises")
```


```{=html}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Z-Test P-Value Explorer</title>

  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: #f5f6f8;
      color: #222222;
    }

    .ztp-app {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-calculator-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-card {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid #dddddd;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-card-header {
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F6BB6;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-card-body {
      padding: 1rem;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .ztp-app label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .ztp-app input[type="number"] {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
      border: 1px solid #cccccc;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .ztp-app hr {
      margin: 1.2rem 0;
      border: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid #dddddd;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-test-options {
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      border: 0;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-test-options legend {
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-radio-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-radio-option input {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
      margin: 0;
      accent-color: #3F68B6;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-help-text {
      margin: 0;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.93rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-plot-title {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-chart-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 320px;
    }

    .ztp-app canvas {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-calculation-result {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-result-label {
      color: #333333;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-result-value {
      color: #3F68B6;
      font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
      font-size: 1.18rem;
    }

    .ztp-app .ztp-input-error {
      min-height: 1.4em;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      color: #b00020;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ztp-app input:focus-visible,
    .ztp-app canvas:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.38);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .ztp-app .ztp-calculator-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ztp-app .ztp-chart-wrapper {
        height: 280px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      body { padding: 0.5rem; }

      .ztp-app .ztp-card-body {
        padding: 0.9rem;
      }

      .ztp-app .ztp-chart-wrapper {
        height: 250px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<main class="ztp-app">

  <div class="ztp-calculator-row">

    <section class="ztp-card" aria-labelledby="ztp-parameters-heading">
      <div class="ztp-card-header" id="ztp-parameters-heading">
        Input parameters
      </div>

      <div class="ztp-card-body">
        <div class="ztp-form-group">
          <label for="ztp-zscore">Z-score:</label>
          <input
            id="ztp-zscore"
            type="number"
            value="1.96"
            step="0.01"
            min="-8"
            max="8"
            inputmode="decimal"
            aria-describedby="ztp-zscore-help ztp-input-error">

          <div id="ztp-zscore-help" class="ztp-help-text">
            Enter a Z-score between −8 and 8.
          </div>

          <div
            id="ztp-input-error"
            class="ztp-input-error"
            role="alert"
            aria-live="assertive">
          </div>
        </div>

        <fieldset class="ztp-test-options">
          <legend>Test type:</legend>

          <label class="ztp-radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="ztp-test-type"
              value="two"
              checked>
            <span>Two-tailed</span>
          </label>

          <label class="ztp-radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="ztp-test-type"
              value="upper">
            <span>One-tailed (upper)</span>
          </label>

          <label class="ztp-radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="ztp-test-type"
              value="lower">
            <span>One-tailed (lower)</span>
          </label>
        </fieldset>

        <hr>

        <p class="ztp-help-text">
          This app demonstrates p-values in the standard normal distribution
          for use in Z-testing.
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="ztp-card" aria-labelledby="ztp-plot-heading">
      <div class="ztp-card-header" id="ztp-plot-heading">
        Graphical representation
      </div>

      <div class="ztp-card-body">
        <div class="ztp-plot-title" id="ztp-plot-title">
          Two-tailed test with z = 1.96
        </div>

        <div class="ztp-chart-wrapper">
          <canvas
            id="ztp-density-chart"
            tabindex="0"
            role="img"
            aria-describedby="ztp-chart-description"
            aria-label="Standard normal density plot with two shaded tails">
          </canvas>
        </div>

        <p id="ztp-chart-description" class="ztp-help-text">
          The blue shaded region represents the p-value for the selected test.
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

  </div>

  <section class="ztp-card" aria-labelledby="ztp-result-heading">
    <div class="ztp-card-header" id="ztp-result-heading">
      Result
    </div>

    <div class="ztp-card-body">
      <div
        id="ztp-result"
        class="ztp-calculation-result"
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-atomic="true">
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

</main>

<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  const app = document.querySelector(".ztp-app");
  if (!app) return;

  const zInput = app.querySelector("#ztp-zscore");
  const error = app.querySelector("#ztp-input-error");
  const plotTitle = app.querySelector("#ztp-plot-title");
  const result = app.querySelector("#ztp-result");
  const chartDescription = app.querySelector("#ztp-chart-description");
  const canvas = app.querySelector("#ztp-density-chart");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  function erf(value) {
    const sign = value < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const z = Math.abs(value);
    const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * z);

    const approximation = 1 -
      (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t + 1.421413741) * t -
      0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t) * Math.exp(-z * z);

    return sign * approximation;
  }

  function normalCDF(value) {
    return 0.5 * (1 + erf(value / Math.sqrt(2)));
  }

  function normalPDF(value) {
    return Math.exp(-0.5 * value * value) / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI);
  }

  function getTestType() {
    const selected = app.querySelector(
      'input[name="ztp-test-type"]:checked'
    );

    return selected ? selected.value : "two";
  }

  function validateZScore() {
    const z = Number(zInput.value);
    let message = "";

    if (!Number.isFinite(z)) {
      message = "Enter a valid numerical Z-score.";
    } else if (z < -8 || z > 8) {
      message = "Enter a Z-score between −8 and 8.";
    }

    error.textContent = message;
    zInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");

    return message ? null : z;
  }

  function calculate(z, testType) {
    let probability;
    let label;

    if (testType === "two") {
      probability = 2 * normalCDF(-Math.abs(z));
      label = "Two-tailed p-value";
    } else if (testType === "upper") {
      probability = 1 - normalCDF(z);
      label = "Upper-tailed p-value";
    } else {
      probability = normalCDF(z);
      label = "Lower-tailed p-value";
    }

    probability = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, probability));

    return { probability, label };
  }

  function testName(testType) {
    if (testType === "two") return "Two-tailed test";
    if (testType === "upper") return "Upper-tailed test";
    return "Lower-tailed test";
  }

  function drawChart(z, testType, calculation) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const width = rect.width;
    const height = rect.height;
    const padding = { left: 58, right: 20, top: 22, bottom: 50 };
    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const xMinimum = -4;
    const xMaximum = 4;
    const yMaximum = 0.44;
    const pointCount = 800;

    function xScale(value) {
      return padding.left +
        ((value - xMinimum) / (xMaximum - xMinimum)) * chartWidth;
    }

    function yScale(value) {
      return padding.top + chartHeight -
        (value / yMaximum) * chartHeight;
    }

    function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
      return Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, value));
    }

    function fillArea(start, end) {
      const boundedStart = clamp(start, xMinimum, xMaximum);
      const boundedEnd = clamp(end, xMinimum, xMaximum);
      if (boundedEnd <= boundedStart) return;

      const count = Math.max(
        2,
        Math.round(pointCount * (boundedEnd - boundedStart) /
        (xMaximum - xMinimum))
      );

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(boundedStart), yScale(0));

      for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) {
        const value = boundedStart +
          (i / count) * (boundedEnd - boundedStart);
        ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(normalPDF(value)));
      }

      ctx.lineTo(xScale(boundedEnd), yScale(0));
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(63, 107, 182, 0.55)";
      ctx.fill();
    }

    function drawBoundary(value) {
      if (value < xMinimum || value > xMaximum) return;

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#3F6BB6";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xScale(value), yScale(0));
      ctx.lineTo(xScale(value), yScale(normalPDF(value)));
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const density = i * 0.1;
      const y = yScale(density);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#e5e5e5";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#555555";
      ctx.fillText(density.toFixed(1), padding.left - 8, y);
    }

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    for (let value = -4; value <= 4; value++) {
      const x = xScale(value);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "#eeeeee";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, padding.top);
      ctx.lineTo(x, padding.top + chartHeight);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
      ctx.fillText(value, x, padding.top + chartHeight + 20);
    }

    if (testType === "two") {
      const boundary = Math.abs(z);
      fillArea(xMinimum, -boundary);
      fillArea(boundary, xMaximum);
      drawBoundary(-boundary);
      drawBoundary(boundary);
    } else if (testType === "upper") {
      fillArea(z, xMaximum);
      drawBoundary(z);
    } else {
      fillArea(xMinimum, z);
      drawBoundary(z);
    }

    ctx.beginPath();

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointCount; i++) {
      const value = xMinimum +
        (i / pointCount) * (xMaximum - xMinimum);
      const x = xScale(value);
      const y = yScale(normalPDF(value));

      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#222222";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xScale(0), padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(xScale(0), padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.strokeStyle = "#777777";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padding.left, padding.top);
    ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, padding.top + chartHeight);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#333333";
    ctx.font = "13px Arial";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(
      "Z-score",
      padding.left + chartWidth / 2,
      height - 8
    );

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(15, padding.top + chartHeight / 2);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Density", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();

    const description =
      `${testName(testType)} with z equal to ${z.toFixed(2)}. ` +
      `The blue shaded region represents a p-value of ` +
      `${calculation.probability.toFixed(6)}.`;

    canvas.setAttribute("aria-label", description);
    chartDescription.textContent = description;
  }

  function update() {
    const z = validateZScore();
    const testType = getTestType();

    if (z === null) {
      result.textContent =
        "Enter a valid Z-score to calculate the p-value.";
      plotTitle.textContent = "Standard normal distribution";
      chartDescription.textContent =
        "The graph is unavailable because the Z-score is invalid.";
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      return;
    }

    const calculation = calculate(z, testType);

    plotTitle.textContent =
      `${testName(testType)} with z = ${z.toFixed(2)}`;

    result.innerHTML =
      `<span class="ztp-result-label">${calculation.label}: </span>` +
      `<span class="ztp-result-value">` +
      `${calculation.probability.toFixed(6)}</span>`;

    drawChart(z, testType, calculation);
  }

  zInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  app.querySelectorAll('input[name="ztp-test-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  let resizeTimer;

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = window.setTimeout(update, 80);
  });

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

```
